source_units.text: Compose a prose elegy for an imaginary bridge.
Make the voice dignified and wistful.
Keep the complete piece to 55–85 words.
Include the following invented details: The Willow Span is an imaginary timber bridge retiring after forty winters.
Its boards carried market baskets and wedding processions.
Use the image footsteps in the wood.
Preserve these exact phrases: "the Willow Span", "forty winters", "footsteps in the wood".
